resolution: Black bars round 2 (bevel trigger) + persisting Add Cylinder refusal on the now-saved Model_34. Measured the saved package: base.blob is fully healthy (128 tris, zero degenerates, UVs spread over [0,1]) and doc/parts round-trip clean — the black is NOT on disk. Traced the resident chain: bevel's preview parents colors totally (inheritFaceRgba validates every src_face), so bevel only PROPAGATES black rows that an earlier op already zeroed in the session color table — prime suspects are merge faces (authoredGroups 60→57→54 in their dump) / symmetrize / loop cut, whose indexed installs need a color-parenting audit; the user has a reliable repro recipe (same edit chain on a fresh cube) which fits the RJIT_MESHOPS headless harness for bisection next session. Decisive experiment given colors re-derive on open: close + reopen Model 34 — bars should vanish. Add Cylinder still refusing is expected: the running binary predates the req_3465 host fix (77f5cee27); until the rebuild, entering Paint once (creating the atlas) unblocks appends. Package's layout.stale marker is routine post-topology state, not the fault.
